summary: Preserve staging evidence and refuse unmanaged governed worktrees

delivery.outcome: Publish and independently merge retention of staging evidence, removal of implicit pruning, and explicit refusal of unmanaged staging in governed repositories.
nonGoals: Implementing a protected execution controller adapter
Enabling the Willman readiness flag without admitted execution
Changing direct-apply mode or model routing

architecture.decision: Keep legacy unmanaged staging for unmanaged repositories; refuse governed staging before Git effects. Preserve changed HEAD, dirty, ignored and interrupted staging, and never prune unknown registrations or delete orphan directories.
architecture.rollback: Revert the material implementation commit without removing retained worktrees.

validation.evidence: Real-Git regressions for preservation of orphan data, dirty and ignored contents, unique commits and interruption; governed staging is refused before verification or mutation.
